title: It may be the start of spooky season, but I’m feeling a jolt of the C...
transcript: every Christmas my dad watched a Christmas Story on repeat he laughed at every line like it was brand new pointing out the moments he loved most usually to me the movie wasn't just entertainment for him it was his childhood the Midwestern world that he grew up in and our house was filled with lake lamps because he loved it that much and everyone knew go take that almost two years ago in December we lost my dad and he had just missed his favourite season the one that brought him the most joy so a few weeks ago when auditions were proposed for a local production of a Christmas Story the musical life at home was pretty overwhelming my mother who had been living with us yes ma'am uh was experiencing some health concerns and we knew things would just get more complex as we went on but as a family we agreed this was worth it and like always we figured it out together so that's why being cast as the old man in a Christmas Story the musical means so much to me I honestly didn't expect it even finding the courage to do something scary like dancing on camera for the audition felt like part of this tribute to my dad so for me this isn't just a role it's a way to honour my dad and do something that I know he'd love
